figures.source: Both careers usually start at a services company near Rs 3.5 to 7 LPA. Work out whether your family can carry that while you build proof for a product company or GCC. If it cannot, a steady first offer with one project built beside the job is safer than a costly course.

blocks.heading: Budget Check: Data Scientist Vs Software

figures.label: Education Budget Amount
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: take a family education budget of Rs 4 lakh. A tenth is Rs 40,000 and a fifth is Rs 80,000, so a Rs 1.5 lakh data science bootcamp sits far above the warning line. Keep the rest for a laptop, practice tools, books and a reserve while you look for work.

visuals.heading: Path Stalls, and Which One Scales Further

items.text: Pick a narrow type of customer, such as clinics, small online shops or coaching centres, and one clear problem.
Start with people you know and ask happy clients for a referral right after a good result.
Put scope, price and a deposit in writing before you start, and price any change request separately.
Watch one number: how many enquiries turn into paid work.
Check GST and Udyam (MSME) registration rules on the official portals once paid work grows, because thresholds change.
Do not depend on one freelance platform.
